text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          extensions: mbstring, intl
          coverage: none
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --no-suggest
      - name: Run wp i18n audit command
        run: |
          vendor/bin/wp i18n audit . --format=json
      - name: Run wp i18n audit command with GitHub Actions format
        run: |
          vendor/bin/wp i18n audit . --format=github-actions
```
